structured.answer: Altshuler Shaham's עוקב מדדי מניות track at 0.56% (0% on deposits) is the cheapest I saw, with Menora right behind at 0.57%. I only counted 9 of the 11 tracks the page says it has, so two might be missing.

stuck.why: The arrow made me think the list was sorted by fee, cheapest first, but the first row (מור 0.67%) was dearer than the ones under it. The list is sorted by company size, so I had to check every row myself.
The header says 11 tracks of 11 companies but I counted 9. I don't know if some rows got lost between the screens.

findings.what: Fees are only shown as tiny percents, nothing in shekels for an amount like mine, so the 0.56 vs 0.67 difference feels like nothing
